setup: @c1 command action=create shape=rectangle color=brown size=large name=Trunk width=60 height=300 at=400,330
text: ok the brown thing is the big oak. put a platform on top of it, wide and gray

wires.span: put a platform on top of it, wide and gray

adjudicated.why: Names rule: a one-word noun is a name, not a label; "on top of it" gives onTop with anchor Trunk.

text: make it wood coloured not gray

adjudicated.why: Pronoun rule: "it" is the shape named platform, so the name is used; a label mention does not apply because the shape carries no label.

text: ladder on the left, long thin one

wires.span: ladder on the left, long thin one

adjudicated.why: Names rule: a one-word noun is a name, not a label.

text: walls: two squares on the platform, side by side

wires.span: walls: two squares on the platform, side by side

adjudicated.why: Heading-word rule ("Pantry: a green box" -> name) gives name=walls (walls, walls2); both annotators left the name out, and the anchor is the name platform.

text: roof. red triangle
bigger, it should cover both walls

adjudicated.why: Both resize the roof, an unnamed session shape and so a mention, with no scale; they differ only in mention form and span.

text: window on the left wall, little yellow circle

wires.span: window on the left wall, little yellow circle

adjudicated.why: One named shape is written by its name: the left wall is walls; a mention with position=left names a canvas place, not the left wall.

text: same on the right

adjudicated.why: One named shape is written by its name: the right wall is walls2, not a canvas-place mention.

text: door: a tall rectangle between the walls

wires.span: door: a tall rectangle between the walls

adjudicated.why: The heading word gives name=door, and "the walls" are the named shapes walls and walls2; A's position mentions pick canvas places, and B drops the name.

text: sorry the door goes on the right wall not between

wires.span: the door goes on the right wall

adjudicated.why: Self-correction keeps the final wish only; the door and the right wall are named shapes (door, walls2), written by name.

text: a rope from the roof to the trunk

wires.span: a rope from the roof to the trunk

adjudicated.why: A rope is a plain line, which the lines rule writes as arrow=none; the spec does not settle it, and an arrowhead would be something the person did not ask for.

text: no, dashed

adjudicated.why: Both set the style of the existing rope to dashed (a change to an existing line is set); they differ only in the roof mention's form.

text: a flag on top. small, blue

wires.span: a flag on top. small, blue

adjudicated.why: "on top" names no shape, so it is the canvas place top (onTop needs an anchor and none is stated), and a one-word noun is a name, not a label.

text: the sun, orange, top right corner

wires.span: the sun, orange, top right corner

text: title: My Tree House, at the top

wires.span: title: My Tree House, at the top

text: group the walls and the roof and call it House

wires.span: group the walls and the roof and call it House

adjudicated.why: Both pick exactly the two walls and the one triangle roof (a mention that picks exactly them) and name the group House; they differ only in the roof mention's form.

text: how many windows did I end up with

wires.span: how many windows did I end up with

text: circle called Start, green, on the left

wires.span: circle called Start, green, on the left

text: then a box: Read ticket
arrow from start
diamond after it, says Urgent?

adjudicated.why: Both anchor on the Read ticket box, an unnamed session shape and so a mention; they differ only in mention form.

text: yes goes up to a box Call customer, no goes down to Send template

adjudicated.why: The branches ask for arrows as well as boxes, written in the order stated; their targets are made in the message, so the reference is allowed even though the engine runs in sequence.

text: label the arrows yes and no

adjudicated.why: Both label the two branch arrows (label takes from, to, label) and differ only in the diamond mention's form; the engine errors carry over from the earlier step.

text: both of those into a box Close ticket

adjudicated.why: Wires come in the order the text states them (A breaks span order), and the target is made in the message.

text: Close ticket red
hm no, make it gray. red looks like an error

adjudicated.why: Both point the pronoun at the Close ticket box, an unnamed session shape and so a mention; they differ only in mention form.

text: also we have an escalation: if the call fails, back to Read ticket

wires.span: if the call fails, back to Read ticket

text: dotted please
Send template should say Send macro

wires.span: Send template should say Send macro

text: line them all up, it's a mess
you made the diamond tiny

adjudicated.why: A complaint gives the wish inside, a bigger diamond (resize with no scale grows it), not a fact stating it is tiny.
